card.name: Linking words before a named therapy
card.fires_on: Small linking words (after, on, of, and, with, receiving) that sit right before a named drug or treatment regimen in dosing and trial text. Also seen inside a drug name or number.

modes.label: Link before drug name
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction such as with, and, or of leads into a named drug or combination.
modes.example: in combination<< with>> rituximab or obinut

modes.label: Link before therapy phrase
modes.description: After, on or of introduces a treatment course or prior therapy.
modes.example: patients with relapsed or refractory CLL or SLL<< after>> at least two prior lines of systemic therapy

modes.label: Inside drug names or doses
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug name or a dose figure.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like tre-, Demonstr-, cl- and away from prescription words, so the next word is less likely to be about prescribing.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a drug or treatment name in label text.
